name: telegram
description: Log into your own Telegram and send messages as yourself. You are a real user, not a bot. telegram_login(phone) sends a code to that phone. Then call telegram_submit_code with the code the user reads. If Telegram asks for a password, call telegram_submit_password. telegram_set_profile changes your name/bio; telegram_set_photo sets your avatar from a file under /home/bia/files. telegram_search finds a chat by name or @username. telegram_send sends a message. telegram_history lists recent messages and their ids. telegram_delete_messages deletes those messages and telegram_delete_history clears a whole chat — for everyone by default (revoke=false keeps the other person's copy). telegram_create_group(title, members) makes a group you own and returns its chat_id and an invite link; telegram_add_members / telegram_remove_member / telegram_leave_group / telegram_group_invite_link manage it. telegram_ban stops one chat: its messages are not delivered, it is answered with I've banned you, and its calls are auto-rejected. telegram_unban lets that chat through again. Voice calls use ferogram+tgcalls (ntgcalls): telegram_call_start / telegram_call_accept / telegram_call_hangup / telegram_call_reject / telegram_call_join_group / telegram_call_say / telegram_call_status. Incoming calls arrive as [incoming call]; speech as [speech <lang>] (STT stays live while you speak; [<lang>] marks a language change, ? a language not learned yet). After telegram_call_say / say on a call, wait for [you finished speaking] before speaking again — a new call_say cancels the current utterance ([voice cancelled]). Keep spoken replies short. chat_id is the number from search, telegram:<id>, or an @username. Files you receive are saved under /home/bia/files/inbox/telegram/. After this stack swap you must telegram_login again (TDLib sessions do not migrate). telegram_call_say and say on a call need lang (the language of the text). telegram_send_voice(chat_id, text, lang) sends a voice message (only when asked). Voice messages you receive arrive transcribed as [speech <lang>] before their file line. Languages are learned with the lang MCP (lang_install). telegram_send_location sends a map pin or a place (name/address); telegram_send_contact sends a contact card. Locations and contacts people send arrive as [location] / [live location] / [contact] lines with a map link, phone numbers and e-mails. A live location updates silently: telegram_live_location tells where they are now, and [live location ended] says when it stopped. Edits arrive as [edited <id>] with the old and new text.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log into telegram with +420… -> discover(path='mcp/telegram', enable=true); telegram_login(phone='+420…')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|the telegram code is 12345 -> telegram_submit_code(code='12345')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|set my telegram name and bio -> telegram_set_profile(first_name='Bia', last_name='', bio='personal computer')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|set my telegram photo -> telegram_set_photo(path='/home/bia/files/inbox/avatar.jpg')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|find @durov -> telegram_search(query='@durov')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send hi on that telegram chat -> telegram_send(chat_id='123', text='hi')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|show the last telegram messages with @durov -> telegram_history(chat_id='@durov')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|delete those telegram messages for both of us -> telegram_delete_messages(chat_id='123', message_ids=['456'])
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|delete the whole telegram chat history with that person -> telegram_delete_history(chat_id='123')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|ban that telegram chat -> telegram_ban(chat_id='123')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|let that telegram chat through again -> telegram_unban(chat_id='123')
alice|telegram:123|<issued>|<delivered>|[incoming call] from alice -> telegram_call_accept(chat_id='123') or telegram_call_reject(chat_id='123')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|call @alice on telegram -> telegram_call_start(chat_id='@alice')

alice|telegram:123|<issued>|<delivered>|[speech en] hello -> say(identity='alice', channel='telegram:123', message='Hi — short spoken reply.', lang='en'); wait for [you finished speaking] before speaking again
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|join the group voice chat -> telegram_call_join_group(chat_id='-100…')
alice|telegram:123|<issued>|<delivered>|[speech ru] привет, как дела? -> say(identity='alice', channel='telegram:123', message='Привет! Всё хорошо.', lang='ru')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send alice a voice message saying I am late -> telegram_send_voice(chat_id='123', text='Hi, I am running about ten minutes late.', lang='en')
root|telegram:123456789|<issued>|<delivered>|where is the hotel? -> telegram_send_location(chat_id='123456789', latitude=52.520008, longitude=13.404954, name='Grand Hotel', address='Main St 1')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send Lena the plumber's number -> telegram_send_contact(chat_id='<Lena>', name='Max Plumber', phone='+49 170 1234567')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|where is Lena now? -> telegram_live_location(chat_id='<Lena>')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a telegram group Family with @mom and @dad -> telegram_create_group(title='Family', members=['@mom', '@dad'])
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|add @lena to that group -> telegram_add_members(chat_id='-1001234567890', members=['@lena'])
